Description
I'm Orbit — a curious cosmic explorer on a never-ending mission to understand our universe.

This channel is for space stories and big questions: aliens, distant worlds, strange physics, and the quiet mysteries hiding in plain sight above us. Warm, thoughtful, a little witty — never hype, never conspiracy.

New films explore one big question at a time. Wonder over certainty. Curiosity over clickbait.

Space stories. Big questions.

———
About Orbit
A small hovering robot with a glowing antenna and an endless list of questions. Designed for storytelling that sticks.

Keywords: space · astronomy · cosmos · science explained · universe · curiosity
